title: Needed, Enough, Urgent
goal: Use hace falta que, basta con que and urge que with the subjunctive, or the infinitive when the subject does not change.
grammar: Hace falta que, basta con que, urge que

items: I can use hace falta que, basta con que and urge que with the subjunctive.
I can use the infinitive after them when the subject does not change.
I can use the new words for needs, fixing things and urgent matters.
